legend: We all know that GukiZ often plays with arrays.

Now he is thinking about this problem: how many arrays a, of length n, with non-negative elements strictly less then 2l meet the following condition: ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/02bd933699313baffa5788fedb6b21a78354f37e.png)? Here operation ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/625ed07379e4df241affcda9308db4df81849a5f.png) means bitwise AND (in Pascal it is equivalent to and, in C/C++/Java/Python it is equivalent to &), operation ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d8e629dfc5d72ed17b4f7da6266cd97331093ddf.png) means bitwise OR (in Pascal it is equivalent to ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d8e629dfc5d72ed17b4f7da6266cd97331093ddf.png), in C/C++/Java/Python it is equivalent to |).
Because the answer can be quite large, calculate it modulo m. This time GukiZ hasn't come up with solution, and needs you to help him!
input: First and the only line of input contains four integers n, k, l, m (2 ≤ n ≤ 1018, 0 ≤ k ≤ 1018, 0 ≤ l ≤ 64, 1 ≤ m ≤ 109 + 7).
output: In the single line print the number of arrays satisfying the condition above modulo m.
note: In the first sample, satisfying arrays are {1, 1}, {3, 1}, {1, 3}.
In the second sample, only satisfying array is {1, 1}.

legend.ai: 众所周知，GukiZ 经常摆弄数组。

现在，他正在思考这样一个问题：长度为 n、元素均为非负数且严格小于 2l 的数组 a 中，有多少个满足以下条件：![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/02bd933699313baffa5788fedb6b21a78354f37e.png)？其中，运算 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/625ed07379e4df241affcda9308db4df81849a5f.png) 表示按位与运算(在 Pascal 中等价于 and，在 C/C++/Java/Python 中等价于 &)，运算 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d8e629dfc5d72ed17b4f7da6266cd97331093ddf.png) 表示按位或运算(在 Pascal 中等价于 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d8e629dfc5d72ed17b4f7da6266cd97331093ddf.png)，在 C/C++/Java/Python 中等价于 |)。
由于答案可能非常大，请你将其对 m 取模。这一次 GukiZ 还没有想出解决方案，需要你的帮助！

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，满足条件的数组为 {1, 1}、{3, 1}、{1, 3}。
在第二个样例中，唯一满足条件的数组为 {1, 1}。

input.ai: 输入的第一行也是唯一一行包含四个整数 n、k、l、m（2 ≤ n ≤ 1018，0 ≤ k ≤ 1018，0 ≤ l ≤ 64，1 ≤ m ≤ 109 + 7）。

output.ai: 在单独一行中输出满足上述条件的数组数量对 m 取模的结果。
